verdict.rationale: Factory documents assigning a Linear or Jira issue to Factory, or mentioning @Factory, so Droid will 'investigate, implement, and test the work'. That covers diagnosing and fixing a reported issue end to end. The fix then goes through diff review and merge, and droid exec adds tiered autonomy for unattended runs. Missing for 10: bug-specific documentation of root-cause diagnosis or reproduction steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
